publicationStmt.p: CC BY-NC 4.0 (the edition's copyright page and the dataset's README and LICENSE)

The text is the Hebrew running text of Moshe Florentin and Abraham Tal, The Samaritan Pentateuch: An English Translation with a Parallel Annotated Hebrew Text (Open Book Publishers, 2024, https://doi.org/10.11647/OBP.0415), which presents MS Nablus 6 diplomatically, as extracted by the CACCHT Samaritan Pentateuch project. The source archive publishes it as JSON, not XML; this file is a TEI P5 transcription made from that data.

Text the edition takes from other manuscripts for the lost beginning (Gen 1:1 to 3:24) is marked with supplied (reason="lost"), naming the edition's stated source. The edition says it filled a few small lacunae from Cambridge Add 714 and the Abisha scroll without marking them; they are not marked here either.
